method: deterministic rule-based screening estimates; not reference labels and not accuracy validated
feature_sources_used: provided regional strata tables: population/urbanization and building proxy fields
feature_sources_not_used: removed TIGER/Line, Microsoft building footprints, USGS facilities, CBP
feature_source_ablation_note: The contrast is strata demographic-only fallback versus demographics plus supplied strata building proxies. Raw Overture geometry was not tract-aggregated in this diagnostic; no Overture-derived per-tract counts or accuracy claim are implied.
gap_estimate_note: 0.5 neutral component placeholders isolate inclusion/divisor arithmetic; not scored predictions

rules.poi_defined_cbp: 1 when pop_total >= 500 OR pct_urban >= 0.20; if all component heuristics are 0, conservatively include CBP as an unresolved-composite fallback (not evidence of a count)
rules.building_defined: 1 when either observed supplied strata building proxy is >0; if both are null/non-finite, use pop_total >= 1 (never null-to-zero)
rules.missing_pct_urban: missing urban fraction supplies no positive urban evidence; do not impute zero; other observed predictors remain usable
rules.poi_defined: 1 when either the facility half has at least one flagged type or the CBP half is flagged
rules.coverage_gap_score_estimate: mean of flagged transport, building and POI component estimates; POI is mean of available facility and CBP halves
